distribution.reason: Candidate only; actual runtime/source/license and application qualification evidence is pending.

constraints: Linux amd64, glibc 2.41; softoken plus its NSS/NSPR closure is supplied in-image with an ld.so.conf entry. Token-present index 1 is the P11Lab database token; its native slot ID is 2.
The adapter always selects configdir sql:/var/lib/p11lab/nss with fixed dbTokenDescription P11Lab, via generated NSS_LIB_PARAMS_FILE and the baked Linux default /etc/nss/params.config.

Initialize only an empty writable /var/lib/p11lab volume; the SQL database is private to the named nss directory. Compatible init is non-destructive; partial or incompatible state fails. certutil -N never runs against existing state.

PIN_FILE/SO_PIN_FILE are preferred; scalar alternatives are explicit disposable-test inputs. Conflicting scalar/file or absent/empty credentials fail initial provisioning. The SO credential satisfies the shared checker protocol only; softoken has no SO role.

Runtime controls/config are recreated under writable /run/p11lab by every invocation. The adapter preserves argv and native/application exit status. Health opens the real certificate database with the pinned stock certutil.
Ordinary application consumers do not require checker, Python, tracing or a workspace mount. Reset is an explicit removal/replacement of disposable state; no automatic reset or retry.
Whole-image licensing, source companion delivery and digest-bound admission remain separate requirements.
